overall_assessment: Read all 20 packet courses (14 suspects and 6 controls), including all visible full-plan and extractor text; packet-imposed truncation markers were not counted as extraction failures. Most main sections and learning-outcome groups survive, and repetition flags on real teaching methods, prerequisites and exam designs are false alarms; LER-3101’s teaching-leak flag is a legitimate coursework task, while the ODO coursework leak is real and its reading-list flag does not establish a separate defect from the visible material. Systematic loss of exam-language design, occasional semantic misclassification and incomplete coursework/prerequisite routing remain, with administrative contamination also demonstrated by random controls.

findings.evidence: Examination questions will be given in English, but may be answered either in English or a Scandinavian language.
findings.description: Combined teaching/examination-language blocks are systematically discarded, losing assessment design explicitly required by course_plan_spec.md. Explicit allowed-answer-language rules disappear in STA-3003, FYS-3730 and JUR-3902; shared exam-language statements also disappear in controls. BIO-8806 has an explicit exam-language rule but no assessment section at all. This is unrelated to packet truncation markers.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps both Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk and Language of instruction and examination to .drop.
findings.suggested_fix: Process combined language blocks before discarding them: route explicit examination-language sentences to assessment, and retain the original combined heading with a shared language value so its meaning survives. Exclude teaching-only language sentences.

findings.evidence: Følgende arbeidskrav må være oppfylt for at spesialistkandidaten skal få ta slutteksamen:
findings.description: ODO-6302 learning_outcomes consists entirely of exam-gating arbeidskrav, while actual knowledge and clinical-skill outcomes remain under course_content. No coursework_requirements row is emitted. The leak->coursework_requirements flag is real; the visible course_content also proves semantic misclassification independently of any reading-list flag.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The UiT reader recognizes the outer Om emnet and Hva lærer du blocks but not the embedded clinical-outcome and Arbeidskrav labels; page_sections() does not split coursework inside learning_outcomes.
findings.suggested_fix: Expose embedded standalone Arbeidskrav and clinical knowledge/skills labels as section boundaries. Route the complete observed Arbeidskrav block to coursework_requirements even under Hva lærer du, and route outcome statements introduced by Kandidaten skal/Etter fullført kurs to learning_outcomes with their subject grouping.

findings.description: A substantive standalone Praksis subsection occurs in the visible plan and course_content output, but no practice overlay is extracted. Unlike LER-3101, whose practice text is only a pointer and is correctly omitted, this subsection states actual practical activities.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R sectionize() only detects a text-line practice heading when current is teaching_methods, and .opens_sentence() also rejects short list items. This Praksis label is inside course_content and is absent from the reader heading list.
findings.suggested_fix: Expose this embedded Praksis label and its next peer boundary as reader subheadings; route the activities to teaching_methods and copy them to practice. Accept substantive short activity lists while continuing to reject bare labels and pointers.

findings.evidence: For studenter som tar emnet som videreutdanning er forkunnskapskravet fullført lærerutdanning med minimum 60 studiepoeng i norsk.
findings.description: The explicit subject-specific prior-education requirement is lost with the Opptakskrav block and no prerequisites row remains. The separate Jf. opptakskrav/progresjonskrav pointer is correctly omitted; it does not replace the substantive requirement of completed teacher education and 60 credits in Norwegian.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps Opptakskrav to .drop before inspecting its content; inline prerequisite recovery only examines course_content.
findings.suggested_fix: Before dropping UiT admission blocks, recover sentences explicitly stating a forkunnskapskrav and a completed prior subject qualification or credits. Route this full sentence to prerequisites and discard only the remaining admission text.

findings.evidence: Det forutsettes grunnleggende kunnskaper i kjemi, biokjemi og mikrobiologi.
findings.description: The prerequisites row contains the two required course codes, but the additional explicit prior-knowledge requirement is left in course_content. The section is therefore incomplete despite its correctly mapped prerequisite heading.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .split_inline_prerequisites() recognizes prerequisite labels, while UiT sentence moves do not cover unlabelled Det forutsettes ... kunnskaper requirements.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an anchored UiT sentence move from course_content to prerequisites for Det forutsettes grunnleggende kunnskaper i followed by subject matter; append it to existing prerequisites without copying it into both sections.

findings.evidence: skal løses og leveres inn individuelt eller i gruppe, og om krav til antall godkjente oppgaver for å gå opp til skriftlig eksamen.
findings.description: Assessment retains both the numbered compulsory-assignment gate and the written exam worth 100%; no coursework_requirements section is emitted. The incomplete wording already exists in the source and is not an extractor truncation. GEO-2007 and HIS-1007 demonstrate that other inline gates are successfully separated.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .inline_coursework_regex expects the numbered lead and godkjente oppgaver on one line; BED-2017 separates them with a blank line, so the intended UiT rule fails.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognize numbered assessment paragraphs across internal line/paragraph breaks when the item states approved assignments as a condition for the exam. Move the complete first numbered item to coursework_requirements and stop at the second numbered graded-exam item.

findings.evidence: Lectures: 40 h Coursework: 30 h Three mandatory homework sets.
findings.description: Mandatory coursework descriptions remain in teaching_methods even though related gate/approval text is extracted separately into coursework_requirements. STA-3003 loses the three-homework description from its requirements section; BIO-2606 leaves the required scientific-article seminar description under teaching. Preserve the lecture hours and seminar supervision as teaching, but assign mandatory-work specifications to coursework_requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: page_sections() applies inline-heading splitting to teaching_methods, but sentence-level gate recognition does not gather adjacent mandatory-work descriptions without an explicit exam condition or recognized label.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend teaching-to-coursework splitting to the observed counted mandatory homework and Studentene skal avholde et obligatorisk seminar sentences. Move their complete task specifications to coursework_requirements, retaining ordinary teaching and supervision sentences.

findings.description: Assessment retains exam locations, submission-calendar logistics and inline resit rights/rules. Examples include the Tromsø venue and resit/postponement notices in HEL-6308, the May submission deadline in SPL-6900, and the resit-right sentence in ARK-3021 and HIS-1007. Random controls confirm the defect. Durations, grading, weights and assessment forms are legitimate design, so repeated short exam tables are false boilerplate alarms.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Real Kontinuasjonseksamen subheadings map to .drop, but embedded labels and sentences survive. R/extract_sections.R .logistics_sentences$uit covers workload rather than these logistics.
findings.suggested_fix: Add UiT sentence-level cleanup for exam venues, submission-calendar notices and resit eligibility/timing; recognize embedded Kontinuasjonseksamen labels. Preserve assessment forms, duration, weighting and grading when removing surrounding logistics.

findings.evidence: Emnet evalueres muntlig eller skriftlig minimum en gang hvert tredje år.
findings.description: Teaching methods retain administrative course-quality evaluation notices in three courses, including two random controls. LER-3101 also retains the Kvalitetssikring label. These are course evaluation procedures, not teaching or student feedback activities.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .evaluation_part_regex recognizes Emneevaluering headings but not Kvalitetssikring or the observed unheaded Emnet evalueres/Emnet vil bli evaluert sentences.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend evaluation cleanup to standalone Kvalitetssikring blocks and the observed course-evaluation sentences in teaching_methods. Keep pedagogical feedback and student assessment descriptions.

findings.evidence: Valgfritt masteremne. Kan blant annet brukes som støtteemne i historie og religionsvitenskap
findings.description: ARK-3021 learning_outcomes contains only study-programme placement rather than anything students know or can do. HEL-6308 course_content retains minimum/maximum admission-capacity rules. Both are administrative plan text outside the canonical sections, retained because the outer heading maps to a substantive section.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading map treats Mål as learning_outcomes and Om emnet as course_content; UiT admission cleanup does not cover programme-placement sentences or minimum/maximum intake notices.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop anchored programme-placement-only Mål text and intake-capacity sentences from UiT sections, while retaining them in course_plan. Remove a section row if this leaves no substantive content.

findings.evidence: Kontakt studiekonsulenten for informasjon om tilgjengelige prosjektoppgaver.
findings.description: The sole reading_list text is a contact notice about available project topics, with no literature or syllabus information. It should not become a reading-list section. Other bare reading-list pointers and Leganto widget notices in the packet are correctly removed under course_plan_spec.md.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Pensum heading maps to reading_list, and placeholder cleanup misses this project-information contact variant.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an anchored whole-placeholder rule for this contact notice in reading_list; omit the row when no substantive reading material remains.
